mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.job_id AS jobId, j.title AS jobTitle, c.name AS companyName, a.status, a.created_at AS createdAt FROM applications a JOIN jobs j ON a.job_id = j.id JOIN companies c ON j.company_id = c.id WHERE a.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY a.created_at DESC

SELECT a.id AS applicationId, a.user_id AS userId, r.name AS candidateName, r.expect_category AS expectCategory, dcat.label AS expectCategoryLabel, dcity.label AS expectCityLabel, r.expect_salary_min AS expectSalaryMin, r.expect_salary_max AS expectSalaryMax, (CASE WHEN r.expect_category = j.category THEN 3 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN r.expect_city = j.city THEN 2 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN j.salary_min <= r.expect_salary_max OR j.salary_max >= r.expect_salary_min THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS matchScore, a.status, a.created_at AS appliedAt FROM applications a JOIN jobs j ON a.job_id = j.id JOIN resumes r ON a.user_id = r.user_id LEFT JOIN dict_items dcat ON r.expect_category = dcat.code AND dcat.dict_type = 'category' LEFT JOIN dict_items dcity ON r.expect_city = dcity.code AND dcity.dict_type = 'city' WHERE a.job_id = #{jobId} ORDER BY matchScore DESC, a.created_at DESC
